In the space there are Jaws and Duk hee their space ship is broken and does not has fuel. So Jaws want to get with head quarter that send them. But Duk hee already used  transmitter for his silly invention things that makes a lot foods from little stuffs.
so they fight each other. at that time a monster that roam in the space attacked their space ship. they fight for survival but they are eaten. In the monster stomach Duk hee got idea for get rid of monster from the ship. then they went to other planet.

snippet.description:

After argument with her mom, Yundoo wishes her mother to be gone.  
Next day, instead of her disappeared mom, Yundoo happens to meet her mother Kyungsoon who became younger.  Yundoo enjoys the reality of her mother’s absence, and lives as she wishes, freely.

snippet.description:
마음의 형태(The Shape Of Heart)-청강대 애니메이션 2017졸업작품(animation)

In some world.  The clover people with a clover shaped heart, and a heart          shaped heart live withouth knowing each other.  Cloe with clover heart happened    to go over a wall between border line of two villages by incident.  Over the wall,    Cloe gets to meet Hearty with a heart shaped heart and the world that she did     not recognize before.

snippet.title: 러브스파크(Love Spark)-짝을 찾아 달로 가는 세상에서 만난..._청강대 애니메이션스쿨 2017년 졸업작품(animation)
snippet.description:
모두가 짝을 찾아 달로 가는 세상.
외로운 너드는 짝을 찾고 싶지만 아무도 쳐다봐 주지 않는다. 
자신과 비슷한 처지의 덩치를 만나지만 그에게도 무시당한다.
너드는 집으로 돌아와 슬픔에 빠지고 덩치는 또 한번의 시도를 하다가 너드의 집으로 추락한다. 둘은 하늘을 바라보며 슬픔에 잠긴다.
그러던 중 너드는 자신이 만든 전구들로 하늘에 떠오를 방법을 생각해내고 그들은 자신들만의 방식으로 빛을 낸다.
The world where everyone leaves for the moom to look for his/her mate.
Although, a lonely Nerd wanted to meet his mate, no one was interested in him.  
He met Dungchi who was in similar situation as him, he got ignored even by him.  Nerd came home with sadness, and Dungchi happened to fall into Nerd’s house after one more try.  Those two felt sad, looking up at the moon.  Meanwhile, Nerd got an idea to fly up into the sky with his lights which is his invention, and they emitted by their own method. 

제작 : 최유진, 김명주, 이선명

러닝타임 : 8' 54"

snippet.title: 닥터본(Dr.Bone)-휴식이 필요한 정신과 의사의 이야기_청강대 애니메이션스쿨 졸업작품(animation)
snippet.description:
자신을 찾는 손님들에게 둘러 싸여 사는 정신과 의사 본.
닥터 본은 자신에게 끊임없이 고통을 토해내는 손님들에게 지쳐버린다.
그렇게 피곤에 지쳐 쪽잠에 빠져버리고, 닥터본은 꿈 속에서 달콤한 휴식을 맛본다.
닥터 본은 꿈 속에서의 휴식이 너무나 즐거운 나머지, 본분을 잊고 자신을 따라다니던 손님들에게서 도망치게 되는데...
Dr. Born, a psychiatrist who lives a busy life surrounded by his patients.  Dr. Born gets exhausted by his patients who constantly pours out their pain onto him.  Meanwhile, he falls into a sleep from his tiredness, and feels such a sweet rest in his dream.  Dr. Born who felt so happy with his rest in his dream, he runs away from his patients away from his duty.  

제작 : 김주원
청강대 애니메이션스쿨 졸업작품
Chungkang College of Cultural Industries School of Animaiton
Graduation Film

snippet.title: Shadow Thief(그림자 도둑)-각기 다른 모양의 그림자를 가진 세상에서 적응하지 못하는 주인공의 이야기_청강대 애니메이션스쿨 졸업작품(animation)
snippet.description:
똑같이 생긴 사람들은 각각 다른 모양의 그림자를 가지고 있다. 
 주인공 ‘시완’은 취업을 하기 위해 노력하지만 회사에서 원하는 그림자 모양과 다르다는 이유로 계속해서 면접에서 떨어진다.
회사가 원하는 모양대로 자신의 그림자를 바꾸지만 취업에 실패하고 자신의 원래 모습도 잃게 된다. 

People with the same look have each different form of shadow.  .  The main character,  ‘시완’ tries to get a job, but, with the reason why his shadow is different from the one the company looks for, he keeps failing in interview.  Although he changes his shadow as the company desires, he still fails to get hired, and gets to lose his original looks.

제작 : 김희예, 양윤영, 김유신, 한승룡
